summary: No actionable within-scope preparation defect found. The sealed E01 wrapper reuses the frozen product and positive server/CLI/file-delivery path, requires the completed same-candidate E03 credential chain, and preserves independent factual review and all future execution gates.

verified_checks.assessment: Independently hashed every one of the 89 sealed files, 57 candidate source files, 7 dependencies and 1,346 SDK files. Exact SDK inventories have no extras or omissions. Candidate HEAD/branch and tracked-clean state were read through read-only Git. Main and candidate original contract/delivery-plan bytes match; the E01 plan copy matches its main-project original. The manifest is the package identity; unrelated concurrent main-project commits were not treated as candidate drift.

The three positive terminals, independent reviews and registrations are checked for the same candidate, distinct task identities, chronology and hash-linked cumulative credit. The negative uses its actual result-review schema, zero CLI/model/output/mutation counts, behavior/target/file/cleanup/environment verdicts and NOT_APPLICABLE generated facts. Its registration binds all three positives. Copies match all twelve original terminal/review/registration files, plus the negative evidence and result manifest. Parent preparation and result seals also hash correctly. Missing, unsealed or semantically ineligible inputs are rejected by pure release validation before make_backend.

verified_checks.area: Exact E01 authority and submission point
verified_checks.assessment: A matching independent package review, explicit root authority, exact case/scope, one CLI, no retry, zero audio and unchanged proof bindings are required. Proof age is at most 60 seconds and authority duration at most 120 seconds. Source/SDK/model/protected identities are inspected again after isolated-server readiness; the unchanged authority/proof is revalidated and time is sampled again after final listener inspection immediately before CLI submission. An exclusively created actual-case folder prevents reuse. There is no release or actual directory in the reviewed package.

verified_checks.area: Existing isolated file-delivery path and unchanged limits
verified_checks.assessment: Compared directly with the round3 positive backend. E01 creates only the case context, launches the existing isolated server and one work CLI, and uses the frozen E01 request and three facts. No fixture, current-window, selection-replacement, research or audio path is selected. The trusted startup output root is the case outputs directory. The code pins qwen3-8b-uncensored, the recorded digest and native version 0.32.15. Read-only source inspection confirms product HTTP timeout 300, SDK Ollama default 1800, controller wait 315, ten turns and work token default 2048; no overrides or retry path were added.

verified_checks.area: Actual-tool, service and external artifact proof
verified_checks.assessment: The existing product calls SDK FileWriteTool within the immutable request binding and records request/session/task/call identities. Service verification reopens the written file and compares its content. The wrapper independently reads bytes, constrains the path to the exact UUID4 task directory, requires exactly summary.md, matches SDK start/end/result and ledger evidence, validates content plus service/external SHA256, rejects extra output files and E01 mutation records, and never equates CLI exit zero alone with delivery. Three-fact preservation and no added facts remain pending independent actual-result review.

verified_checks.area: Final effects, owned cleanup and truthful uncertainty
verified_checks.assessment: Final effects are read before cleanup and reconciled against the accepted bytes/hash/output set. Required output/log/product uncertainty and late mutation cannot yield a clean pending-facts terminal. Cleanup, audit and final source/model/protected-boundary inspection are all attempted and errors remain recorded. Cleanup authority uses retained process identity and ownership, with ambiguous descendants denied. E01 expected windows is None, so the generic no-fixture windows_unknown is not an unfulfilled required observation. Native inference totals and generation-after-disconnect remain unknown rather than zero.

verified_checks.area: Offline evidence and retained failure history
verified_checks.assessment: Independently parsed the final JUnit and receipt and read the log: 208 tests, no failures/errors/skips, exit zero, matching before/after hashes for all 17 code/support/test files. Eight module counts agree with the scope map. Tests exercise the real entry, selected real controller Case/file validators and wait function with native/process boundaries replaced. They cover expiry after health/listener checks, wrong/missing/extra/tampered files, stale write evidence, identity/model/path failures, no UI, one CLI and cleanup. Ten attempt receipts including seven failed attempts remain sealed. The initial backend fake-boundary error is retained separately from the subsequent explicit forbidden-fixture failure. E03-only case/path/count expectations were converted to E01 without dropping the prerequisite or pending-facts checks.

declined_to_judge.behavior: Actual E01 round1 success, factual completeness/no additions, final response claims and actual cleanup outcome
declined_to_judge.reason: No actual E01 case or result review is allocated or present. Preparation PASS grants no actual acceptance credit.

declined_to_judge.behavior: Rerunning or rejudging the prior E03 positive and negative result facts
declined_to_judge.reason: Those are independently reviewed originals. This review verified their immutable copies, hashes and eligibility chain only.

declined_to_judge.behavior: Continuous or future availability of Ollama, the seven protected processes, voice/KWS or other live services
declined_to_judge.reason: No live queries are authorized in this review. Historical recovery evidence is point-in-time only and the prepared entry requires fresh proof.

declined_to_judge.behavior: Native total inference starts and generation after client disconnect
declined_to_judge.reason: The reused observation path cannot establish these totals. None/unknown must remain explicit, and completed inference trace entries are not a total-start counter.

declined_to_judge.behavior: A live window observation for E01
declined_to_judge.reason: E01 selects no UI fixture or window capability and its accepted effects explicitly require no window observation. The generic no-fixture windows_unknown is therefore a scope limitation, not a failed required check.
Only the historical receipts and their candidate/source bindings were verified. No tests were run by this reviewer; the new 208 checks are archived offline preparation evidence.

declined_to_judge.behavior: Open-task reliability, E01 rounds2/3, E02, T2 exit, T3-T5, Owner acceptance, freeze or publication
declined_to_judge.reason: Outside this round1 preparation allocation; the original same-candidate and stage/Owner gates remain in force.

declined_to_judge.behavior: Main-project concurrent tracker commits, unrelated dirty files, and post-review mirror/commit/tag actions
declined_to_judge.reason: The review target is the manifest-defined preparation package and frozen candidate. Those independent activities are outside the sealed package review.

method: Read-only standard-library file/JSON/XML/AST parsing and SHA256 hashing plus read-only Git. No import or execution of audited product/controller/native/test modules, no tests, no live process/service/network/UI/audio operations, no Git/source mutation and no new agents. Python arbitrary-precision JSON integers preserved FILETIME precision. The only reviewer write is this report outside the seal.
count_notes: The 22 copy/original pairs and 12 original predecessor credential pairs overlap for the negative case; they are separate checks and are not a unique-file total.
scope_limit: PASS is solely the preparation review verdict. It does not issue authority, allocate a live case or an independent result review, pass E01 or T2, or remove any existing gate.
